主要内容: King & Spalding's New York office added Samaa Haridi as a partner in its Trial and Global Disputes practice group. Haridi, a trilingual lawyer with over 20 years of experience in international commercial and investment arbitrations, focuses on disputes involving clients in the Middle East and emerging markets. She joins from Hogan Lovells, where she led its Middle East practice. Haridi is fluent in French and Arabic and conversant in Spanish. She is also currently serving as a vice president of the ICC International Court of Arbitration and senior co-chair of the Arbitration Committee of the International Bar Association. Andy Bayman, head of the Trial and Global Disputes practice group, stated that Haridi's connections in the Middle East will strengthen the firm's international arbitration team. Edward Kehoe, co-head of the International Arbitration and Litigation team, praised Haridi's entrepreneurial spirit and her ability to cultivate relationships with clients and colleagues. Haridi expressed her enthusiasm for joining King & Spalding, noting the firm's outstanding reputation in international arbitration.
